description: Return a panel-friendly fundamentals time series derived from normalized EDGAR statements. This endpoint is for canonical statement facts over time; the /v1/modeling routes answer from a point-in-time as-of snapshot instead. The endpoint supports a CIK universe, canonical metric selection, annual/quarterly frequency, and a deterministic time window. Deterministic ordering: stable sort with a fixed tie-break, so pages never overlap.

ciks.description: Companies named by CIK. Repeat the parameter (for example `?ciks=0000320193&ciks=0000789019`) or separate CIKs with commas. Send this or `tickers`, not both. At most 25 companies per request.

core_metrics_only.description: When true and `metrics` is omitted, restrict the series to the core metrics of the requested statement_type, from: REVENUE, GROSS_PROFIT, OPERATING_INCOME, NET_INCOME, BASIC_EPS, DILUTED_EPS, TOTAL_ASSETS, TOTAL_LIABILITIES, TOTAL_EQUITY, CASH_AND_CASH_EQUIVALENTS, LONG_TERM_DEBT, NET_CASH_FROM_OPERATING_ACTIVITIES, CAPITAL_EXPENDITURES, FREE_CASH_FLOW and NET_INCREASE_DECREASE_IN_CASH.

from.description: Inclusive lower bound for statement_date (YYYY-MM-DD). When omitted, defaults to 1994-01-01.

items.description:
Canonical financial statement metrics.

The enum names are UPPER_SNAKE_CASE and the values are the same strings,
ensuring stable identifiers in JSON and other serialized forms.

metrics.description: Optional subset of canonical metrics to include. When omitted, all metrics present in the underlying normalized payloads are considered for each point.

page_size.description: Maximum number of items to return per page (1–200).

statement_type.description: Statement type to use as the source of fundamentals (e.g., INCOME_STATEMENT).

tickers.description: Companies named by ticker symbol, in place of `ciks`; send one or the other. Repeat the parameter or separate symbols with commas. Each resolves to the company whose filings hold its statements as of the request's as-of or period-end date, or as of today when the request has none. At most 25 companies per request.

to.description: Inclusive upper bound for statement_date (YYYY-MM-DD). When omitted, defaults to today's date.

name: fundamentals_time_series
title: Fundamentals time series
